title: Resume work from durable task state and searchable Codex history
description: Persistent continuation is integrated into the existing scripts/repo-map/query_map.py --resume entry point and AGENTS.md. Beads Rust 0.7.4 holds task state in .beads/issues.jsonl; CASS 0.10.0 on WSL retrieves existing Codex history with workspace filters, bounded snippets and explicit coverage/freshness warnings. Commands live in ignored .codex/continuity.json. Native Windows CASS 0.10.0 selftest crashes during shutdown despite printing success; use the verified WSL binary. The CASS index skips 12 oversized sources; use the documented bounded rg fallback instead of repeating full indexing. See notes for verified restoration, source retrieval and resource limits.
acceptance_criteria: A separate process retrieves prior closed work and the latest unfinished checkpoint. JSONL alone restores task content and status without the original database. Resume search is bounded and does not reindex implicitly. Unavailable tools, timeouts, stale history and rejected source coverage remain visible. Existing navigation and clone checks are reused.
notes:
2026-10-12 checkpoint: initial CASS Linux 0.10.0 ingestion finished with exit 1. Derived data is 8.8 GB and Windows C: free space is 5.7 GB. Do not rerun full indexing or create another index before diagnosing failure and storage requirements. Original Codex session logs must be preserved. Beads task retrieval survived a separate process and date transition. Next: diagnose CASS status and constrain resource use, verify JSONL recovery, then finish resume integration.
2026-10-12 verification: BR JSONL-only restore in a separate temporary workspace preserved both issue IDs, states, descriptions, notes and timestamps. Resume retrieval took about 3s; CASS search and canonical message expansion recovered an Oct 8 session. Initial indexing retained useful work but source coverage was partial: incremental pass exited 9 for 12 sources over 100 MiB (largest 1.44 GB, over the 1 GiB configurable maximum). No blind full rebuild. rg fallback recovered PreparedGpuOnlyFeatureTwoPassContinuationV2 from the rejected Aug 30 source. CASS GC reclaimed 3,213,641,582 bytes of retired segments. Query now uses --no-maintenance, known workspace filters, index report warnings, canonical message IDs, current Git and latest task notes. 19 unit tests pass. Next: commit/push with the existing duplicate gate, then resume the existing broker/quote-economics path; do not reinstall this tooling.
Final local checks: the existing pre-commit gate passed with 1,023 scanned source files, 3,000 existing clone candidates and zero new clones. The current acceptance checks passed; neo-671 is the next ready product task. Live continuation confirmed it finds closed neo-z5f instead of recreating navigation work. br updated_at sorting is already newest-first; do not add --reverse. Known oversized-source coverage is disclosed, with a verified original-file fallback.
close_reason: Installed and verified separate-process continuation, JSONL-only recovery, old-session retrieval and oversized-source fallback. 19 tests pass. Known history coverage limits are explicit; reuse the existing tooling.

description: Implemented in commits 4e247738, 1585e52a and 03bee0e3. Existing scripts/repo-map supplies the hash-refreshed SQLite graph. Serena 1.7.0 has real Rust/TypeScript definition/reference evidence; jscpd 5.4.1 has real MCP snippet queries and pre-commit/CI duplicate gates. Windows and WSL full scans agreed on 1023 files / 3000 clone candidates / zero new at 03bee0e3. Sixteen tests and GitHub Actions run 38144300499 passed. This verifies navigation and the gate, not trading correctness or profitability. Reuse this implementation.
